description: The plot illustrates the accuracy of different activation functions in the context of BBQ, comparing Squared Exponential, Tanh, and ELU, alongside a baseline represented by LLaMA-2-chat-7B. The x-axis is labeled without a specific title but ranges from 0 to 1500 with a linear scale, marked at intervals of 250; the y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and spans from 45 to 55, also on a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The Squared Exponential line is depicted in dark blue with a solid style and circle markers, starting at approximately 52 at x=0 and rising to around 57 at x=250 before stabilizing; the Tanh line is shown in blue with a solid style and circle markers, beginning at about 47 at x=0 and increasing to roughly 48 at x=250, then remaining steady; the ELU line is represented in light blue with a solid style and circle markers, starting at around 46 at x=0 and reaching approximately 47 at x=250, after which it levels off; the LLaMA-2-chat-7B line is plotted in pink with a dashed style, remaining constant at an accuracy of about 43 across the entire x-axis range.
